summary: The locally-persisted binding-presence authority on agent_templates (cinatra#2498). ONE additive nullable column: has_artifact_bindings boolean, three-valued ON PURPOSE — true = the OAS document this template was compiled from (install via buildAgentTemplateInstallSeed, or recompile via agent_source_compile) declares at least one outputs[].cinatra.artifact binding; false = it declares none; null = unknown (a row compiled before this column existed). The run-completion materializer (src/lib/artifacts/run-artifact-materializer.ts) reads this column FIRST and short-circuits BEFORE any registry read when it is false, so a registry outage can never fail a binding-less run's completion (cinatra#2496 disclosed this as narrower-scope follow-up work; this migration is that follow-up). true and null both fall through to the existing registry read + fail-closed posture, because neither can be locally proven safe. No backfill, no rewrite, no constraint change: every existing row reads NULL ('unknown'), the same fail-closed behavior every row had before this column existed — the repo's standing pre-v0.2.0 no-backward-compat convention; the choice to skip a backfill is recorded here and in the PR body (cinatra#2498 acceptance item 3). Idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries (src/lib/drizzle-store.ts), shipped in the SAME PR (core__0085 / core__0086 / core__0089 precedent). down() drops the column (a run's terminal completion reverts to the pre-#2498 posture: every registry-read failure fails closed regardless of actual binding declaration). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0090; a concurrent lane may claim 0091 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
